lines.en: About Aphrodite.

summary.headline: Aphrodite’s Astrological Significations
summary.text: Astrological account of Aphrodite’s significations, including love, pleasure, adornment, arts, bodily parts, diseases, weather, fertility, wealth, and social outcomes. It also discusses Aphrodite’s co-presence with Hermes and the Moon, including eloquence, education, marriage, jealousy, relatives, children, and mental disturbances.
